title: 2048 with Save
description: Merge tiles to reach 2048. Your progress is saved automatically.
about:
2048 with Save is a browser game where you use the arrow keys to slide all tiles. Matching numbers merge; reach 2048. Use Save and Load to keep a board for later.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Use the arrow keys to slide all tiles. Matching numbers merge; reach 2048. Use Save and Load to keep a board for later.
tips: Use arrow keys to slide tiles.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play 2048 with Save?
faq.answer: Use the arrow keys to slide all tiles. Matching numbers merge; reach 2048. Use Save and Load to keep a board for later.

faq.question: Can I play 2048 with Save in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
